name: PCR ranking instability source audit v1
scope: First four recommended steps: reference alignment, preprocessing/PCA/regression controls, boundary margins, and functional-label checks in existing DepMap holdouts. New single-cell cohort replication is a subsequent task

patient_case.evaluation: 209 historical TCGA Train/Validation patients from the existing expression bridge
patient_case.parameters: Historical PCR rank256 alpha10000; no retuning
patient_case.replay: Same RNG stream as pcr_patient_extension_v1, including consumption of TCGA Train mapping sample after each source draw
patient_case.reference: Original non-Kidney training gene mean; bootstrap raw prediction = local residual + bootstrap mean; common-reference residual = raw prediction - original mean
patient_case.universe: Exactly the existing 14349-gene patient ranking universe

paired_controls.full_refit_local_reference: Original resampled standardization/PCA/regression with its own resampled target mean, reproducing the old estimand
paired_controls.full_refit_common_reference: Identical raw prediction expressed relative to original training gene mean
paired_controls.reference_shift_only: Fixed original raw prediction, subtract resampled target mean; no model fit changed
paired_controls.fixed_geometry_beta_refit: Original standardization and PCA scores; refit regression/intercepts on sampled patients, original target reference
paired_controls.fixed_scaler_pca_beta_refit: Original feature standardization, refit PCA and regression on sampled patients, original target reference
paired_controls.refit_scaler_fixed_pca_beta_refit: Resampled feature standardization, original PCA loading matrix, refit regression/intercepts, original target reference

component_audit.ordered_identity: local full - base = (fixed geometry - base) + (fixed scaler PCA refit - fixed geometry) + (common full - fixed scaler PCA refit) + (local full - common full)
component_audit.outputs: Component prediction mean-square and pairwise signed cross-products, plus exact reconstruction check. Order-dependent conditional contrasts, not causal or orthogonal variance fractions
component_audit.pca_comparison: Principal angles/squared singular values of cross-loading matrices; invariant to column sign flips and within-subspace orthogonal rotation
component_audit.standardization: Report normalized expression-mean drift and log-SD drift descriptively

ranking_diagnostics.boundary: Score at rank k+1 minus score at rank k; count genes within +/-0.01 of score at rank k
ranking_diagnostics.ties: Stable original gene order, with exact ties reported
ranking_diagnostics.not_probabilities: Selection frequencies and rank percentiles describe resampling stability, not calibrated functional probabilities

functional_cases.dataset: Existing DepMap24Q4 baseline matrix; development reuse, not a newly untouched test
functional_cases.outer_cases: All 19 historical whole-lineage holdouts with >=20 models, patient-overlap purged
functional_cases.hyperparameters: Each historical outer-lineage PCR config selected only in that fold's training data; unchanged
functional_cases.ranking_universe: Non-common-essential genes with >=20 observed training outcomes; per-model observed heldout-label mask used for paired scoring. Report coverage differences against historical universe
functional_cases.truth_reference: Original outer-training gene mean for all controls; lower true residual stronger selectivity
functional_cases.control_budget: All six controls and three k values on the same sampled patients; no functional scores select controls or parameters
functional_cases.association: Patient-equal metrics after grouping models by patient within lineage; report overall Spearman and mean within-lineage Spearman; no p-values from bootstrap draws treated as independent subjects
functional_cases.high_low: Within each lineage, predefine high/low stability by average-rank upper/lower thirds; report lineage-equal high-minus-low NDCG descriptive contrast; retain tie-induced group sizes
functional_cases.intervals: 2000 GPU lineage-cluster draws over the 19 per-lineage contrasts, seed20261012; descriptive intervals, overlapping training sets and historical development reuse limit confirmation

limitations: Reference-only contrast may not capture the entire change in the resampled target estimand
PCA subspace overlap is calculated in standardized feature-coordinate space; raw feature metrics differ under scaler refit
50 patient-case and 20 functional-case draws are bounded diagnostic budgets
Larger candidate lists mechanically raise overlap; stability is not accuracy
Existing external and development cohorts have been examined previously
Neither model-selection changes nor clinical/functional claims follow automatically from this audit
